description: April 10 birthday meaning: Aries decan 3, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 10 birthday falls in Aries, in the third decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: The April 10 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Jupiter, ruler of Sagittarius, sub-rules the final decan of Aries, which begins around April 10 with the Sun about twenty degrees into the sign. Ten reduces to 1, so independence meets optimism. Readers describe an adventurous initiator who thinks big, likes to travel or explore ideas, and often encourages others to aim higher.

Astronomically, April 10 puts the Sun near 20° Aries in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. The last ten degrees of Aries fall under Jupiter, the planet that governs Sagittarius, so this decan is usually read as the most philosophical version of the Ram. The urge to act is joined by an urge to understand why, and to go further, physically or intellectually. Astrologers tend to describe these mid-April birthdays as restless explorers who argue for principles as hotly as for themselves. Jupiter can widen the horizon and also the to-do list, so enthusiasm may outrun follow-through. At its best, this decan mixes Aries nerve with a broad, hopeful outlook that makes other people braver about their own plans.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 10
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 10 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 10 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 10 is the 100th day of the year (101st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 10 days, by April 20.

By April 10 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 10 birthday are Steven Seagal (1952), Sadio Mané (1992) and Omar Sharif (1932).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 10?
faq.answer: April 10 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aries, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 10 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 10?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 10, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 10?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 10 include Steven Seagal (1952), Sadio Mané (1992) and Omar Sharif (1932). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
